title: A MOSFET on a heatsink
intro: A MOSFET dissipates 20 W at an ambient of 40 °C. Its heat flows from the junction through the case (0.5 K/W) and the thermal pad (0.2 K/W) into the heatsink, and from the heatsink into the air. Choose the heatsink by its thermal resistance to air, Rsa: the smaller Rsa, the bigger and dearer the heatsink.
checkTj: The junction stays at or below 125 °C.
checkCheap: The heatsink is no bigger than it needs to be (Rsa of at least 3 K/W).
